PLAN "12-Week Cycle-Adjusted Strength Plan for Stage III Endometriosis (2026-06 to 2026-08)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build strength with cycle-aware and flare-window accommodations"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Week 1 - Cycle Day 1-7 baseline":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Week 1 - Accessory emphasis":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_bridge 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Week 1 - Push-pull balance":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x max rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          tricep_extension 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 2 Week 1 - Cycle-friendly volume":
        warmup:
          cycling 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Phase 2 Week 1 - Lower accessory":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 10 reps each side
        main straight_sets:
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          ab_wheel 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          plank 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Phase 2 Week 1 - Upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          row 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          reverse_plank 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 3 Week 1 - Strength emphasis":
        warmup:
          cycling 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_deck 60 seconds
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Phase 3 Week 1 - Accessory strength":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Phase 3 Week 1 - Upper pulling focus":
        warmup:
          rowing 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          face_pull 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 4 Week 1 - Peak strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_thrust 60 seconds
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Phase 4 Week 1 - Upper volume":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          military_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Phase 4 Week 1 - Core and mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          planks 3x60 seconds rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds

FLARE WINDOWS and CYCLE ACCOMMODATIONS
  - Endometriosis flare windows: 2026-07-10 to 2026-07-13 and 2026-08-04 to 2026-08-07
  - For flare days and flow days: remove high-impact, avoid heavy Valsalva, avoid jumping, reduce volume by 20-40% and substitute with submaximal, controlled movements.
  - Proposed adjustments:
    - If a session falls within a flare window or the flow window, modify main sets as follows:
      - Replace 4x6..8, 5x5, or similar high-load sets with 3x8..12 rpe 6-7
      - Remove 180-second rest blocks in favor of 90-120 seconds
      - Swap jump proximity movements with controlled tempo or machine-assisted equivalents
      - If necessary, replace squats/deadlifts with goblet_squat or leg_press at lighter loads
  - Notification: If any exercise conflicts are detected by date, the plan will automatically adjust to the flare-safe variant for that week.

NOTES
- All exercises use canonical vocab as required.
- Cardio warmups/cooldowns use allowed modalities: running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking.
- No HIIT or heavy Valsalva on flare or flow days.
- The program is structured in four phased blocks totaling 12 weeks starting 2026-06-01, with cycle-aware adjustments and explicit flare-window accommodations.
